Setup Overviews: Cross-Application
        Below are lists of the setup procedures required to use the cross-application
 functional areas. 
         
        NOTE: Actions without hyperlinks can be performed by your Manhattan Associates representative.
         
         
        Desktop Setup...
        
            Review Desktop layout records
            Review Desktop functional groups
            Create Desktop templates
            Add Custom Links to the Desktop
        
         
         
        Global Paperwork...
        
            Review the 
 internal print procedures 
            Define the 
 document types
            Create document 
 templates
            Define documents
            Define all 
 print devices
            Define default printers on the user profile
            Identify 
 a documents label and print driver (on the Print Device Window)
            Define document 
 routing records
            Define comment 
 types
            Associate 
 comment types with document types
            Review 
 detail data source values 
            Review 
 paperwork filter records 
            Create 
 document criteria records 
        
         
         
        Group Picking...
        
            Define the picking location group that 
 identifies the locations/work zones where a pick group can operate
            Define the 
 picking group record and link the appropriate picking location groups 
 to it
        
         
         
        GS1 Barcode Setup...
        Inbound RF Processing
        
            Review application 
 identifiers
            Define application 
 identifier template
            Enable GTIN 
 on Item/Item Cross Reference
            Require 
 GS1 Scan on Receiving Preference
        
         
         
        Outbound Label Generation...
        
            Enable GTIN 
 on Item/Item Cross Reference
            Configure 
 the GS1 label according to the Global Paperwork or Wave-Specific Paperwork 
 setup steps.
        
         
         
        Immediate Needs...
        
            Review the immediate needs system values
            Maintain 
 the immediate needs triggers
            Make an 
 item eligible for immediate needs
        
         
         
        Initial System Setup...
        
            Create environments
            Define warehouses
            Define companies
            Define all 
 system users
        
         
         
        Picking Management...
        
            Activate picking management for the 
 appropriate work type(s)
            Activate 
 picking management for the appropriate work zone(s)
        
         
         
        RF Device...
        
            Review the 
 RF screen properties
            Review 
 the RF-related work system values
        
         
         
        RF Group Picking...
        
            Create a group picking work sequence 
 record
        
         
         
        SQL Server Reporting Services Documents...
        
            Define a document as an SSRS document
            Define a document type’s rendered PDF file directory
            Define a warehouse's rendered PDF file directory
        
         
         
        Wave-Specific Paperwork...
        
            Complete the 
 global paperwork steps on the appropriate windows (see "Global Paperwork 
 Setup") 
            Define which 
 wave records require paperwork
            Define document 
 masters
            Create label 
 masters
            Associate 
 a master to the appropriate wave master 
        
         
         
        Window Security...
        
            Create Security Records
        
         
         
        Work Creation...
        
            Create work groups 
            Create work 
 types
            Review the 
 work creation processes
            Define which 
 requests will become work (using work criteria records)
            Define how 
 work is generated
            Create each 
 work creation record on the Work Creation Master Window
        
         
         
        Work Execution...
        
            Review zone 
 types 
            Create work 
 zones
            Establish 
 work teams
            Create advanced 
 user profiles
            Define equipment 
 types
            Define work 
 profiles 
            Define specific 
 handling rules 
            Define estimated 
 work rates records
            Review the 
 work system values 
            Define 
 text messages
            Associate 
 text messages
            Configure/Display 
 Interfaced RF Text Messages
            Escalate Work Record Priority
